title: Failure-Guided Co-Evolution of Prompts and Training Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.15209v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) improves language-model programs by revising prompts from task feedback, yet it typically holds its training data fixed. Repeatedly optimizing against the same instances confines feedback to weaknesses already represented in those data, leaving related failure conditions unexplored. We therefore view each failure as a dual signal: it indicates both how the prompt should be revised and what new training evidence should be synthesized. We introduce FORGE, a failure-guided framework that co-evolves prompts and training data. FORGE abstracts imperfect executions into reusable failure modes and synthesizes new training data through four complementary mutation strategies. Verified instances are fed back into prompt search, allowing updated prompts to expose the next data needs. Across eight heterogeneous benchmarks, FORGE improves the aggregate score over the unoptimized baseline by 16.52 percentage points

translated_title: 失败引导的提示与训练数据协同进化
translated_abstract: 自动提示优化（APO）通过根据任务反馈修改提示来改进语言模型程序，但它通常保持训练数据固定不变。针对相同实例反复进行优化会将反馈局限于这些数据中已经体现的弱点上，使得相关的失败情形无法被探索。因此，我们将每一次失败视为一种双重信号：它既指示了提示应如何修改，也指示了应合成什么样的新训练证据。我们提出了FORGE，一个由失败引导的提示与训练数据协同进化框架。FORGE将有缺陷的执行过程抽象为可复用的失败模式，并通过四种互补的变异策略合成新的训练数据。经验证的实例被反馈回提示搜索过程中，使更新后的提示能够暴露出下一批数据需求。在八个异构基准测试上，FORGE相比未优化的基线将总评分提升了16.52个百分点。
tldr: FORGE框架将失败视为双重信号，通过抽象可复用的失败模式并利用四种变异策略合成新训练数据，实现提示与训练数据的协同进化，在八个基准测试上将总评分提升16.52个百分点。
en_tdlr: FORGE treats failures as dual signals, co-evolving prompts and training data by abstracting reusable failure modes and synthesizing new training data through four mutation strategies, improving aggregate scores by 16.52 percentage points across eight benchmarks.
